result.question: How has Tesla's total revenue changed over its last three fiscal years (2023 to 2025)?
result.answer: Tesla's total revenue over its last three fiscal years (2023–2025) showed modest growth from 2023 to 2024, followed by a decline in 2025. Specifically, total revenue was $96,773 million in FY 2023 [c1], $97,690 million in FY 2024 [c2], and $94,827 million in FY 2025 [c3]. Revenue rose by approximately $917 million (about 0.9%) from 2023 to 2024, but then fell by roughly $2,863 million (about 2.9%) from 2024 to 2025, leaving FY 2025 revenue below the FY 2023 level by about $1,946 million [c1][c2][c3].
